description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of reasoning steps and the Pass@1 Rate for two models. The x-axis is labeled “Num. of Reasoning Steps” and has a linear scale ranging from 5 to 40, with tick labels at intervals of 10. The y-axis is labeled “Pass@1 Rate (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 20. A blue line, marked with circular data points, represents GPT-4o, starting at a value of 19.4 at x=5 and increasing to 83.9 at x=40. The line shows an initial increase to 77.4 at x=20, followed by a decline to 83.9 at x=40. A gray line, marked with ‘x’ data points, represents Claude-3.5-Sonnet, starting at a value of 6.5 at x=5 and increasing to 89.2 at x=40. This line shows an initial increase to 32.3 at x=10, and then to 87.1 at x=20, followed by a slight decline to 89.2 at x=40.
